definitions.full: H6517. parur מָּרוּר noun [masculine] pot (Thes from boiling , dubious; otherwise Kö ii. 1, 151 ); — pot (earthen ? see פרור Ecclus 13:2; Greek χύτρα , opposed to λέβης ; Syriac jar of the potter , opposed to ), for boiling Num 11:8 (JE), 1Sam 2:14 , compare Judg 6:19 ( ᵐ5 χύτρα ), κύθρα ). II. פור see II. פרר .
